title: Bringing it all together
slide_intent: Introduce the move from individual assets to a complete communication. Seeing several elements in use helps a designer judge which element leads and which ones support it.
strategic_value: Combining a human photograph with the brand’s signs and lettering can give a communication both a personal subject and a recognizable author.
demonstration: A pink chapter opener places a photograph, boxed words, a heart and hand-drawn marks in an angled, layered assembly. Introductory copy sits in the open upper-left area.
practical_value: Use the chapter opener to study how to stack type and illustration while keeping the photographic subject visible.

content_islands.name: Chapter opener
content_islands.spec: Keep the title and brief introduction aligned to the left beside the chapter rail.

content_islands.name: Layered example
content_islands.spec: Rotate the photograph and stack the black headline strips, heart, smaller text blocks and marker strokes above it. Place the identity separately on the surrounding pink field.
